risk_reasons: Isolated workspace lifecycle requires independent canvas state machines and background loop throttling to prevent memory leaks and audio bleed
Real hardware acceleration tier switching requires fallback handling for WebGPU device loss and WebGL context restoration without stalling UI thread
Zen mode collapses multiple DOM drawers and sidebars requiring strict keyboard trap management and clean transition states

agent_lanes.designer: Aesthetic top-right Zen mode lock/unlock translucent pill, workspace tab strip with active/paused badges, hardware tier real-time telemetry badge indicators, and smooth collapse transitions.
agent_lanes.fixer: WorkspaceSession state manager in App.tsx (1 workspace per video/image/stream), RenderEngineManager wiring into App rendering loop replacing canvas2d fillText facade with active WebGPU/WebGL2 shaders, real GPU probing via navigator.gpu & WebGL unmasked renderer, and keyboard shortcut handler (Escape, F11).

architecture.system_overview: Tauri v2 native cross-platform application delivering high-performance, dark minimalist ASCII rendering. Architected around three core pillars: (1) Discrete Isolated Workspaces eliminating cross-media collisions, (2) Authentic hardware acceleration tier detection and active execution via WebGPU compute/WebGL2 fragment shaders (zero facade/fillText fallback), and (3) Distraction-free Zen lockscreen mode with translucent top-right unlock trigger.

isolated_workspaces.model: WorkspaceSession (id, title, type: video | image | camera | procedural_3d, state: idle | loading | playing | paused | rendered | error, mediaSource, renderResult, options, proceduralParams)
isolation_guarantees: Zero shared canvas buffer collisions: Each active workspace session possesses distinct media source references, aspect ratio bounds, and render result caches.
Automatic background throttling: Inactive workspaces have their video/camera loops paused and requestAnimationFrame unhooked, preserving CPU/GPU cycles.
Deterministic teardown: Switching workspaces cleanly stops audio tracks, releases Blob URLs, and disposes GPU textures associated with the previous session.
isolated_workspaces.storage_and_state: Managed via App.tsx state with activeWorkspaceId pointer, supporting multiple concurrent tabs with instantaneous switching.

detection_protocol.webgpu_probe: Requests navigator.gpu.requestAdapter({ powerPreference: 'high-performance' }). Queries adapter.info (vendor, architecture, device, description). Requests GPUDevice to verify compute shader capability.
detection_protocol.webgl2_probe: Creates offscreen canvas, requests webgl2 context. Queries WEBGL_debug_renderer_info extension for UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL to identify physical GPU string.
detection_protocol.cpu_probe: Verifies CanvasRenderingContext2D support for CPU baseline.

active_execution_paths.tier1_webgpu: Executes WGSL compute shader via src/lib/renderers/webgpu.ts. Writes directly to WebGPU texture atlas.
active_execution_paths.tier2_webgl: Executes GLSL fragment shader via src/lib/renderers/webgl.ts. Writes directly to WebGL2 texture buffer.
active_execution_paths.tier3_canvas2d: Executes CPU pixel luminance quantization via src/lib/renderers/canvas2d.ts.
active_execution_paths.rust_sidecar: Executes Tauri native Rust batch image processing command via src-tauri/src/commands.rs.

hardware_acceleration_runtime.zero_gimmick_guarantee: App.tsx instantiates and delegates all rendering through RenderEngineManager (src/lib/renderers/manager.ts). The activeTier state directly switches the active renderer pipeline. No hardcoded fillText facade.

zen_lockscreen_mode.ui_specification: Top-right floating translucent pill button ('bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white rounded-full p-2.5 transition-all duration-200 z-50'). Displays Lock icon in normal view, Unlock icon in Zen view.
zen_lockscreen_mode.viewport_behavior: AsciiViewport expands to 100vw x 100vh full bleed container. Preserves monospace character aspect ratio and zoom pan capabilities.

motion_lifecycle.exit: Zen mode panel collapse transition (200ms duration, ease-in-out)
motion_lifecycle.unmount_cleanup: Cancel all rAF/rVFC handles, pause HTMLVideoElement, revoke Blob URLs, stop MediaStream tracks, DOM nodes unmounted cleanly
motion_lifecycle.orchestrated_moment: Single orchestrated load screen boot pulse at application startup; all subsequent tab transitions are snappy and static.

breaking_scenarios.name: Concurrent Media Stream Collision & Resource Bleed
breaking_scenarios.vector: User loads an active 60 FPS video into Workspace 1, switches to Workspace 2 to run a 3D procedural donut, then rapidly inserts an image into Workspace 3
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Canvas context clobbering, audio track leaking in background, procedural render loop racing against video frame callbacks on shared canvas ref
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Each workspace operates its own dedicated WorkspaceSession state. The inactive workspace video element is paused and unhooked from rVFC; procedural animation loop unbinds upon switching out; active workspace canvas receives exclusive paint access with zero artifact bleed
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Isolate render targets by workspace ID; pause inactive streaming handles synchronously during workspace transition

breaking_scenarios.name: WebGPU GPUDevice Lost or Context Interruption During Active Render
breaking_scenarios.vector: User forces hardware tier to WebGPU; GPU encounters device lost (e.g. system sleep, driver reset, or memory threshold violation)
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Uncaught promise rejection in command encoder submission; blank canvas frozen in unrecoverable error state
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: RenderEngineManager listens to GPUDevice.lost promise. Automatically steps down active tier from tier1_webgpu to tier2_webgl (or tier3_canvas2d); notifies user via HardwareTelemetry banner; re-renders active frame seamlessly without dropping session state
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Execute automatic graceful cascade fallback in RenderEngineManager; update active tier sticker to reflect true operating backend

breaking_scenarios.name: Zen Mode Viewport Snap, Window Resize & Keyboard Trapping
breaking_scenarios.vector: User activates Zen lockscreen mode, then hammers Escape key, F11, and resizes OS desktop window rapidly between 640x480 and 4K resolution
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: UI lockup if Escape key handler is blocked; layout overflowing screen bounds or hiding unlock button offscreen; z-index fighting between modal drawers
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Zen mode toggle is bound to root-level global keydown listener with highest priority. Unlock pill maintains fixed top-right coordinate (z-index 50) with safe area insets. AsciiCanvas recalculates monospace character bounds with debounced resize handler
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Guarantee unlock trigger is always visible and accessible; clean toggle back to normal view on any Escape or F11 event

breaking_scenarios.name: Unsupported Video Codec or Corrupted Container
breaking_scenarios.vector: User drops an MKV with unsupported AV1/HEVC codec or 0-byte corrupt file into dropzone
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: HTMLVideoElement triggers 'error' event; unhandled promise rejection in ensureVideoPlaying() or silent black output
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: HTMLVideoElement error listener intercepts error code MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED; pipeline catches error, rejects cleanly, sets user-friendly error sticker 'CODEC_UNSUPPORTED', and preserves existing canvas without blank screen
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Display inline error message explaining supported codecs (MP4, WebM), clean up Blob URL, and reset dropzone state to idle

breaking_scenarios.name: Rapid Mode Switching During Active 60 FPS Video Loop
breaking_scenarios.vector: User selects high-bitrate video, clicks play, and immediately rapid-clicks between 'video', 'camera_stream', and 'procedural_3d' tabs at 10Hz
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Orphaned requestVideoFrameCallback handles writing to detached canvas context; memory leak of unmounted HTMLVideoElements; audio playback continuing in background
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Active stream controller cancelVideoFrameCallback() and video.pause() executed synchronously in useEffect cleanup; offscreen canvas context released; video.src revoked; only single active loop executes
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Enforce strict cancellation token on all frame callbacks; destroy prior pipeline before mounting new active tab

motion_lifecycle.primary_moment: 1.2s hardware handshake boot sequence with clean unmount
motion_lifecycle.secondary_transitions: Instant 0ms-50ms mechanical snaps; smooth 200ms ease-out for top-right zen lockscreen collapse
